decisions.reason: Although it draws on some biomass know-how, the superfood drink mix is furthest from the firm's core industrial process and engineering capabilities, and its limited web presence suggests insufficient early traction to justify continued resource commitment.

The modular waste-to-energy plant extensions fit tightly with the firm's existing knowledge in waste conversion, automation and custom engineering, so its R&D base and university ties should help it improve and commercialize them.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant sits squarely in the firm's core technological domain, and its dedicated web page signals enough strategic importance to keep learning from and refining it.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel is a close adjacent application of the firm's waste-to-energy and chemical-processing capabilities, and the firm's strong absorptive capacity makes continued development more sensible than an early withdrawal.
